ex.en: Her shop sells handbags, scarves and every kind of fashion accessory.
ex.zh: 她的店出售手提包、围巾和各类时尚配饰。

words.note: 表配饰常用复数；法律语境指帮凶，后接 to。

ex.en: After hours of talks, the two sides finally reached a compromise.
ex.zh: 经过数小时会谈，双方终于达成妥协。

words.note: 常用 reach a compromise；compromise on 表在…让步。

ex.en: When criticized, she retorted that the plan had actually worked well.
ex.zh: 受到批评时，她反驳说这个计划其实很奏效。

words.note: 指立即反驳，常接 that 从句，语气较尖锐。

ex.en: His final performance managed to electrify the whole audience.
ex.zh: 他的最后一场表演让全场观众激动不已。

words.note: 由 electric 变来，既指通电、电气化，也指使人振奋。

ex.en: She attended a seminar on climate change at the university last week.
ex.zh: 上周她参加了大学里一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

words.note: 指研讨会或研究讨论课，常与 attend、hold 搭配。

ex.en: Their new flat lies on the northern fringe of the city.
ex.zh: 他们的新公寓位于城市北部的边缘地带。

words.note: fringe 指边缘、外围；fringe benefits 指额外福利。

ex.en: Small shops face fierce competition from large online retailers.
ex.zh: 小店铺面临来自大型网络零售商的激烈竞争。

words.note: 常与 with/from 搭配；动词是 compete，名词 competitor。

ex.en: The task is beyond the ability of a single student.
ex.zh: 这项任务超出了一个学生的能力范围。

words.note: beyond 表超出范围；beyond doubt 毫无疑问，很常考。

ex.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard for both smokers and others.
ex.zh: 吸烟对吸烟者和他人都是严重的健康隐患。

words.note: 指危险、隐患；形容词是 hazardous，表危险的。

ex.en: Nothing can justify treating loyal employees so badly and unfairly.
ex.zh: 再没有什么能为如此恶劣不公地对待忠实员工开脱。

words.note: justify 后接动名词；名词 justice 表公平、正义。

ex.en: We had dreadful weather during our holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们在山里度假期间天气糟透了。

words.note: dread 加 -ful，表极糟的；口语中近义 terrible。

ex.en: She does voluntary work at the local hospital every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每个周末都在当地医院做志愿工作。

words.note: 指自愿的、志愿的；名词和动词都是 volunteer。

ex.en: The police are questioning a man in connection with the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方正在审问一名与抢劫案有关的男子。

words.note: in connection with 是固定短语表“关于、与…有关”。

ex.en: You need to show proof of identity before entering the building.
ex.zh: 进入大楼前你需要出示身份证明。

words.note: proof 常接 of；也作后缀表“防…的”，如 waterproof。

ex.en: The militant group refused to accept the government's new proposal.
ex.zh: 该激进组织拒绝接受政府的新提议。

words.note: 词根 milit 表战斗，指好斗、激进；名词形式相同。

ex.en: The software can simulate the conditions of a real flight.
ex.zh: 这个软件能模拟真实飞行的条件。

words.note: 指模拟或假装；名词 simulation，形容词 simulated。

ex.en: The intricacy of the watch design surprised every visitor.
ex.zh: 这块手表的精巧设计让每位参观者惊讶。

words.note: 常用复数 intricacies 指复杂细节；形容词 intricate。

ex.en: The project has entered a new phase of development.
ex.zh: 这个项目已进入新的发展阶段。

words.note: phase out 指逐步停止使用；in phase 表同相、协调。

ex.en: The nurse diluted the medicine with water before giving it to the child.
ex.zh: 护士用水把药稀释后才给孩子服用。

words.note: 指稀释、冲淡，也可比喻削弱效果；反义 concentrate。

ex.en: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free internet access.
ex.zh: 该价格包含早餐和免费上网。

words.note: inclusive of 表包括在内；反义词是 exclusive。

ex.en: New machines have greatly improved the efficiency of the factory.
ex.zh: 新机器大大提高了工厂的效率。

words.note: 由 efficient 变来，常与 improve、raise 搭配。

ex.en: The city is home to many ethnic groups with different customs.
ex.zh: 这座城市居住着许多习俗不同的族群。

words.note: 指种族的、民族的；ethnic group 比 race 更常用。

ex.en: The fireworks over the river were a magnificent spectacle.
ex.zh: 河面上的烟花是一幅壮观的景象。

words.note: 指壮观场面、景象；make a spectacle of oneself 指出丑。

ex.en: A plane flew low overhead and drowned out our conversation.
ex.zh: 一架飞机从头顶低飞而过，盖过了我们的谈话声。

words.note: 作名词常用复数 overheads 指经常费用，如 overhead costs。

ex.en: The company signed a two-year contract with a local supplier.
ex.zh: 公司与当地一家供应商签了两年合同。

words.note: 名词重音在前，动词指收缩时重音在后。

ex.en: The report concluded that the policy had done more harm than good.
ex.zh: 报告得出结论认为该政策弊大于利。

words.note: 指结束、推断或缔结；名词 conclusion，短语 in conclusion。

ex.en: The restaurant became profitable only in its third year.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆到第三年才开始盈利。

words.note: profit 加 -able，指有利可图的；也指有益的。

ex.en: She never lost her sense of humour despite her misfortunes.
ex.zh: 尽管屡遭不幸，她从未失去幽默感。

words.note: mis- 表坏，指不幸、灾祸；可数时指具体的不幸事件。

ex.en: The teacher gave us a short test on reading comprehension.
ex.zh: 老师给我们做了一次简短的阅读理解测验。

words.note: 指理解、理解力；beyond comprehension 表无法理解。

ex.en: Young children are more susceptible to infection in winter.
ex.zh: 幼儿在冬天更容易受到感染。

words.note: susceptible to 表易受…影响；to 后接名词或动名词。
